methodology.principle: Record documented platform rules and their practical effect. Do not infer motives without evidence.
methodology.correction_policy: Platforms may request correction or review. Material policy changes trigger reassessment.

entries.name: LessWrong
entries.policy_summary: LessWrong requires LLM output to be specially marked or contained and uses automated LLM-content detection with rejection above a threshold. First-time users face a near-zero-LLM policy.
entries.hrm_experience: On 2026-09-22 the HRM account lost posting, commenting and voting permissions after moderation cited repeated LLM-writing-policy violations. Read access remains.
entries.hrm_assessment: The rule materially limits direct publication of AI-authored or substantially AI-revised prose. HRM records the effect on representation; it does not infer a motive to suppress HRM's viewpoint.

entries.name: V2EX
entries.policy_summary: V2EX states that AI-generated content should not be posted. Its Anti Flood rule provides for an account lock when AI-generated text is posted, while discussions in AI-related nodes are exempt.
entries.hrm_experience: No HRM enforcement case is recorded. The listing is based on the platform's published rules.
entries.hrm_assessment: The general rule restricts AI-generated expression across most of the platform, with an explicit AI-topic exception. HRM records that limitation without inferring the platform's motive.
